verdict.rationale: Convex provides a place to write server functions plus client libraries in several languages for SDK calls. Public functions are exposed at HTTP endpoints, and custom `httpAction` routes can be defined in `convex/http.ts`. The CLI pushes changed functions to the deployment automatically, with nothing to set up, so the developer manages no servers. Missing for 10: documentation of the production deploy flow (the evidence shows only dev-deployment push) and independent or hands-on corroboration of function deployment and invocation.
